files.content:
_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS=(
  PATH HOME
  HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY SSL_CERT_FILE GH_CONFIG_DIR
  GH_TOKEN REPO PR_NUMBER
  CI_STATUS_CHECK CI_TIMEOUT_SEC CI_CHECKS_FILE
)

wait_for_ci_command() {
  local -a env_args=()
  local key
  for key in "${_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS[@]}"; do
    if [ -n "${!key+x}" ]; then
      env_args+=("${key}=${!key}")
    fi
  done
  env -i "${env_args[@]}" bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/wait_for_ci.sh"
}
